headline: A mayor found a way to make petrol cheaper
summary: A small municipality in Abruzzo bought a petrol station four years ago. Fuel there now costs up to 20 cents less than elsewhere.
why: Municipal ownership of fuel retail is an unusual local model that can affect regional pump prices.

original_headline: Un sindaco ha trovato il modo di fare pagare meno la benzina
